verses.text: By David. A psalm for reflection. Blessed are those whose rebellion is forgiven and whose sin is covered.
Blessed are those whose wrongdoing the LORD doesn't count against them, who have no deceit in their spirit.
When I kept quiet, my bones wore down as I groaned all day.
Day and night your hand weighed on me. My strength dried up like water in the summer heat. Selah.
I admitted my sin to you. I stopped hiding what I'd done. I said, “I'll confess my rebellion to the LORD,” and you forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah.
So let everyone faithful pray to you while you can be found. When mighty waters rise, they won't reach them.
You're my hiding place. You keep me safe from trouble and surround me with songs of rescue. Selah.
I'll teach you the way you should go. I'll give you advice and keep my eye on you.
Don't be like a horse or a mule that doesn't understand. It takes a bit and bridle to steer them, or they won't come near you.
The wicked go through plenty of sorrow, but faithful love surrounds those who trust the LORD.
Be glad in the LORD and celebrate, you who do what's right! Shout for joy, all of you with honest hearts! 🙌
